en.basel-kadem: 1.	My father, may Allah grant him mercy, said: We were told by Sa’d bin Abdullah, from Ahmad bin Muhammed bin Isa, from Muhammed bin Khalid al-Barqi, from the one he mentioned, from Hafs bin Ghiyath, from Abu Abdillah, peace be upon him,

with regards to the saying of Allah, Exalted and Glorious is He: «And all of them, We devastated a (complete) devastation» [25:39]. He said: It means: We crushed a (complete) crushing. He said: It is in Nabatean.
